body:
Your fixes mostly survive, with three refinements:
1) Do not mix representative and adversarial claims into one statistical denominator. Use a frozen representative stratum for a one-sided 95% false-SUPPORT upper bound <1%, and a separately enumerated adversarial/security suite requiring zero critical escapes. Measure verifier verdict before human approval so approval cannot hide model defects. Define severity and claim sampling before the run.
2) `N/N-1` is not a minimum invariant; it creates compatibility work. Simpler greenfield gate: every participant handshakes `releaseId/protocolRange/buildId`, readiness requires a compatible cohort, active sessions pin loaded builds, and deploys never activate a new SW mid-session. Support N-1 only if rolling deployment evidence requires it.
3) Stage-vs-server reconciliation needs a dedicated immutable display binding/epoch, not controllerEpoch. A local Stage can be authoritative for rendered playback only while its display binding/deck manifest remains valid; if takeover/rebind occurred during partition, reconnect must enter RECONCILE_REQUIRED.
Also, `<=400 mixed claims, zero failures` is insufficient unless eligible yield/relevance has its own denominator; abstain-all trivially passes safety/latency.
